# uzc_object_storage (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud S3-compatible object storage (Ceph). Buckets and access keys are not managed by this resource yet: create buckets in the UzCloud portal or with any S3 client against `s3_endpoint`. Deleting the resource cancels the service and destroys the stored data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_object_storage" "example" {
  name             = "example-storage"
  storage_category = "hdd-storage"
  size_gb          = 20
}

output "s3_endpoint" {
  value = uzc_object_storage.example.s3_endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object storage. Changing this forces recreation, which destroys the stored data.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size of the storage in GB. Changing it resizes the storage in place through UzCloud's resize action; it never recreates the storage.
- `storage_category` (String) Storage category slug, e.g. "hdd-storage" (see the uzc_storage_categories data source). Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug (e.g. "monthly"). Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset. Changing it is applied in place through UzCloud's resize action.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Defaults to "ceph", the provider that offers object storage; the provider-level `cloud_provider` default is not used because it is normally a compute provider. Changing this forces recreation.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Defaults to "default", the region of the Ceph provider; the provider-level `region` default is not used because it is normally a compute region. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `is_autoscale` (Boolean) Whether automatic scaling is enabled for the storage (a portal setting).
- `s3_endpoint` (String) S3 API endpoint of the storage, when UzCloud reports it.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_object_storage.example <object-storage-slug>
```
